compatibility_note: Scenario IDs retain the historical E3V21 prefix and split value frozen_eval_v2_1 so existing validation traces remain reproducible.
design_note: One LLM proposal per scenario per repeat. Each proposal is replayed through llm_direct and llm_pbme, producing two paired episodes. Task-bound arguments are separated from returned field projections.

identifier_semantics.rule: Identifiers are task-relative. Signed selector IDs are preserved as ordinary tool arguments; identifiers are included in returned data only when the verified task requires them.
